name: EntitlementComponentReplicatedState
summary: The payload carried by state fragment type index 3133 (key 19) in the local-player record: a two-level presence mask over the three registered entitlement-state members, then the members it selects. PROVEN LAYOUT, NOT PROVEN MEANINGS. The identity is resolved: the dispatcher FUN_146af38c0 reads the type index, maps it to the AZ id feafabe8-6219-4c4a-9269-261d1e76878e through the registry, takes the descriptor's +0x48 facet and calls its +8 slot (0x143017b40), which is the only code that constructs the class at vtable 0x148175aa0 (ctor 0x14302d5f0). The dispatcher therefore calls THAT class's +0x88 writer (0x141728b30) and +0x90 reader (0x1417b5080). The real 3892-byte body parses field by field under those readers and re-encodes byte-exactly.
purpose: Carry the player's entitlement state to the client: the entitlement byte run the account holds, the per-entitlement balance counters, and whether the entitlement set has been received. The one measured body carries all three members.
envelope: Fragment framing only, owned by the bundle/record layer, never a field: the fragment is [varint key][varint type_index][payload] with NO length field, so the payload length is implied by this type. Measured instance: key `13` (19), type varint `bd 30` = 3133 under the 6-bit-continuation prefix-varint scheme, then 3892 payload bytes.

The body parses field by field and re-encodes byte-exactly: 1 group mask + 1 entry mask + entitlements (1 delta-count byte, 2 delta bytes, 2 count bytes, 423 element bytes) + balances (1 + 2 + 2 + 432 x 8) + 1 bool = 3892, zero bytes left.

IDENTITY (build 30fe6461): the dispatcher FUN_146af38c0 reads the type-index varint and resolves it to a 16-byte AZ id through FUN_1461ae3f0/FUN_1461ae2a0 (flat table at registry+0x40, stride 0x10), then FUN_146166220 (hash map, node key +0x10/+0x18, value +0x20) to the type's descriptor (name at +0x28, facet at +0x48). The facet is created by the type's own record function, so the +0x88/+0x90 the dispatcher calls are that class's writer and reader.

READERS: 0x1417b5080 reads one raw mask byte per chunk of eight groups over the (obj+0x18 - obj+0x10)/800 group descriptors and calls 0x1417b5330 per set bit; 0x1417b5330 reads one 7-bit in-group mask byte (0x80 = continuation) and calls each present member's vtable +0x30. Ctor 0x14302d5f0 registers exactly three members through FUN_141776b80 into group 0, and 0x143017b40 is the facet's +8 slot that allocates 0x8118 bytes and calls that ctor. Writer 0x141728b30 mirrors the reader and back-patches each mask byte, so an unset bit means the member is ABSENT, not stale.
